LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_Greeting: The courier shifts a heavy mailbag, sweat dripping from their whiskers. They look around wearily, then ask if this is {Interviewer_labelShort} — admitting they lost their way along the winding trail.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_OptNews: Ask what they have seen on the road.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_OptBack: Back to the matter at hand.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_News1: "The trade route through the eastern valley is shut — RKU partisans and kingdom guards have been skirmishing near the old bridge again."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_News2: "The autumn harvest in Rakinia is looking good, though the high taxes have the farmers grumbling into their beer."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_News3: "A cold front is sweeping down from the northern peaks — travellers say the mountain passes are already freezing over."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_Farewell: The courier tightens the straps, tips their cap politely, and steps back onto the road.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_MsgReward: To thank you for the directions, the courier slips you a small handful of silver.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Courier_MsgFood: Clutching the hardtack, the courier is deeply grateful for your kindness on the lonely road.
